selection_rule: Current comparison *_audit.json authoritative_session (19), plus published E79 and E32-868T30D (2) -> imported manifest steps; recovery_overrides.json.steps overrides accepted_result; each effective summary row run_id maps to raw/{run_id}.csv.gz. Failed attempts, quick checks and superseded results are excluded unless explicitly selected by an override.
scope_limit: These 21 campaigns only; archive also contains pilot/diagnostic captures outside this manifest selection. Presence is audited, not gzip CRC or metrology correctness. Published module results without RAW source sessions are audited separately.

truncated_capture_replacement.interpretation: A later authoritative capture covers the same nominal condition/repetition; this is a replacement measurement, not restoration of the old truncated waveform.
